patch_description: Structural redesign around a simulated-annealing core with a two-stage objective pipeline: (1) maximize raw minimum triangle area with points free in the plane, then (2) a hull-shrink stage that affinely contracts the whole configuration toward its centroid — reducing the hull-area denominator while checking that min triangle area degrades slower than hull area, directly attacking the ratio. This exploits the score = min_area/hull_area structure that the previous pure coordinate-descent programs ignored. Multi-start deterministic seeds, vectorized exact triple enumeration, and a global "shrink move" (never tried before) allow escaping the 0.03 plateau. Final result is rescaled so the hull has unit area.
